name: Kachchh Minerals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Kachchh Minerals Ltd is in the business of mineral processing.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KML is engaged in the business of minerals by catering to mineral processing segment through the extraction of various types of silica and China clay, Mineral raw material, etc. These minerals are sometimes sold as raw material or after processing as per requirements of customers.
